subject: Scheduling: Technical Deep-Dive — Availability Roundup & Join Links
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@medixhealth.com>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling: Technical deep-dive — availability & next steps

Hi Ava and Tom,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through Medix Health's ingestion patterns and the inference volume expectations. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use case: anonymized clinical note summarization for downstream analytics.
- Expected steady-state: ~25 QPS, spiky up to ~80 QPS during nightly batches.
- Data residency: US-only; SR requirement for audit logs and role-based access.

Per our call, next step is a technical deep-dive where our infra/eng team can validate model choices, latency SLOs, and integration touchpoints. To move this forward, could you confirm who from your side should be on the deep-dive (engineering, security, product)? Also please confirm preferred meeting platform (Zoom or Google Meet) and your timezone.

Proposed 1-hour slots (all US/PT):
- Option A: Tue Oct 13, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed Oct 14, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Option C: Thu Oct 15, 08:00–09:00 PT

I'll pencil Option B for now pending your confirmation. I'll send a calendar invite with a join link and a short agenda once we confirm attendees. Attaching a stub ICS for planning (tech-deep-dive-invite.ics) and a one-page agenda draft.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
redwoodinference.com

Attachments: tech-deep-dive-invite.ics (stub), brief-agenda.pdf (draft)

Cc: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@medixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T17:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Technical deep-dive — availability & next steps

Thanks Ben — appreciated the clear recap.

We can do Option B (Wed Oct 14, 14:00–15:00 PT). Attendees from our side:
- Ava Collins — Product (will lead use-case scope)
- Tom Reilly — Lead Engineer (integration owner)
- Priya N. — Security (cc'd on calendar once invite goes out)

We prefer Google Meet for internal compliance (SSO + G Suite). Timezone for the attendees is PT.

A few asks before the deep-dive:
- Could you confirm whether Redwood supports SSO-backed model access for private deployments?
- Any pre-reads on your expected token pricing for streaming summarization workloads?

Attaching our internal infra diagram (placeholder) for reference. Look forward to the invite.

—Ava

ava.collins@medixhealth.com

Subject: Confirmed: Technical deep-dive — Wed Oct 14, 14:00 PT (Google Meet)

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Ava.

Confirmed: Wed Oct 14, 14:00–15:00 PT (Google Meet).
Join link: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcq-123
Calendar invite attached (tech-deep-dive-invite.ics). I've cc'd Marissa (solutions engineer) and Soojin (runtime engineer) from our side — they will drive the demo and integration discussion.

Pre-reads and items we'll bring:
- High-level architecture options for low-latency summarization (prefetching, KV cache strategies).
- Pricing estimate for streaming summarization at ~25–80 QPS and expected unit economics.
- Checklist for SSO/HSM integrations and available compliance artifacts.

Action items for Medix before the meeting:
1) Confirm final attendee list (including Priya's full name/email so we can add to invite).
2) Share any short sample payloads or expected sequence lengths (soojin@redwoodinference.com).

Attaching the brief agenda again and the calendar ICS for your calendar.

See you Wed — Ben

Thanks — looking forward. Quick technical note ahead of the meeting:

- If you can share a representative sample of the clinical note payload (redacted) and average sequence length, I can prepare latency projections across model variants and a recommended batching strategy.
- For SSO: we support OIDC flows for Private deployments and can map RBAC to customer identity providers; we'll bring the integration checklist to the call.

I've attached an integration checklist we typically run through during the deep-dive. If anyone on the Medix team can confirm TLS termination and whether they will terminate in front of Redwood (or allow our edge), that will help the session run faster.

See you on Wed — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
